content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Transport Office, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, under the approval of the District Collector, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District. The post works at the Office of the District Transport Office, and applications are received at its office at Anantharam.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Technical skills required: proficiency in computer operations, database management and technical reporting. The notice invites eligible candidates of Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District. It does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, check the official notification.

rows.qualification: Graduation in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university with a meritorious academic record.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries remuneration of Rs. 40,000/-. The notice states that this remuneration will be drawn entirely from the allocated District Road Safety Fund. The engagement is on contract for a period of one year, renewable based on performance.

content_sections.heading: District Transport Office Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Road Safety Co-Ordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Maintain district crash data and the Black Spot Register. Prepare the District Road Safety Plan, minutes, and Action Taken Reports (ATRs). Manage updates on the MoRTH portal. Coordinate between the District, Lead Agency, and Centre of Excellence.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Transport Office Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Road Safety Co-Ordinator
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the website https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/ . Submit the offline application in person at the Office of the District Transport Officer, Anantharam, Bhongir (District Transport Office, Anantharam, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District). Submit it between 23-11-2026 and 30-11-2026, up to 5:00 pm, on office working days. Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below and bring the original certificates for verification. Educational qualification certificates Residential certificate Aadhaar card Study certificates (Bonafide Certificates) covering any four academic years from Class I to Class VII

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice gives the selection method as a total of 100 marks. After the applications are scrutinised, the top 20 (Twenty) eligible candidates will be selected strictly based on their B. Tech percentage. The dates of the written examination and the interview are not specified in the notice.

rows.component: Written examination on Computer Knowledge (20 marks: 20 questions)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the District Transport Office Yadadri Bhuvanagiri recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, for the post of Road Safety Co-Ordinator on contract basis for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 30-11-2026, up to 5:00 pm on office working days. Applications are accepted from 23-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Road Safety Co-Ordinator?
faq.answer: Graduation in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university with a meritorious academic record. Proficiency in computer operations, database management and technical reporting is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Road Safety Co-Ordinator?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 40,000/-, drawn entirely from the allocated District Road Safety Fund.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/ and submit it in person at the District Transport Office, Anantharam, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, with self-attested photocopies of the documents and the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The top 20 eligible candidates are shortlisted strictly on B. Tech percentage. Selection then carries 70% weightage for B. Tech marks, 20% for a Computer Knowledge written examination of 20 questions, and 10% for the personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract post for a period of one year, renewable based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates of Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District within 25 to 35 years who hold the required qualification can apply.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed with the application?
faq.answer: Educational qualification certificates, a residential certificate, an Aadhaar card, and Bonafide study certificates covering any four academic years from Class I to Class VII. Originals are shown for verification.
